name: bash
description: Execute a shell command in the workspace (optional cwd) and return stdout and stderr (last 400 lines or 16KB; the full output is saved as an artifact). Optional timeout is foreground seconds (default 30 seconds); a command still running then moves to the background by itself — never killed for time — returning output so far, last-output age, build phase, and a task_id. Set background=true for >5s or parallel jobs, and description for a short UI label. Call task_shell_wait with that task_id to read more or wait; do not sleep-poll with bash. Before a final answer, collect every still-relevant background task (wait only when genuinely blocked) and cancel any that no longer matter. In Ask, after a sandbox denial, retry the exact command once with sandbox_permissions (the narrowest wider mode that suffices) and a one-sentence justification; the approval prompt asks the user.

background.description: Run immediately in the background and return a task_id (good for >5s or parallel jobs; incompatible with read_only=true). Call task_shell_wait to wait or cancel.

command.description: The command to execute. Actual execution shell: `/bin/bash`. Use Bash syntax: pipelines, redirections, $(command), and && / || are supported. Quote paths and variable expansions, such as "$path"; use single quotes for literal text. For literal multiline input, use a quoted heredoc delimiter (<<'EOF') with its closing delimiter on a separate line. Use only installed programs; do not assume GNU-specific flags on macOS/BSD. Example: printf '%s\n' 'sample'.

description.description: Optional few-word summary shown to the user beside the command.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence explaining why this exact command needs wider access.

read_only.description: Set true to run analysis code (including Python/SQLite) or a network fetch (curl) with mandatory native filesystem read-only isolation. Outbound network is on only in Full Access when the session sandbox, the network policy and your network grant allow it. Available during peer writes. Refused when native enforcement is unavailable; no background, stdin, external backend, or sandbox escalation.

sandbox_permissions.description: The wider sandbox mode this exact command needs. Use only as a one-shot retry after a sandbox denial; requires justification and user approval in Ask.

timeout.description: Optional seconds to wait in the foreground (default 30 seconds). A command still running then is not killed: it moves to the background by itself and you get its output so far, how long ago it last printed, its build phase, and a task_id. Call task_shell_wait directly with that task_id to read more or wait for it; do not sleep-poll with bash.

name: create_goal
description: Start the session's persistent goal for an objective needing more than one turn or verified completion, even if the user did not say "goal". Not for questions or one-shot edits. Work continues across turns until verified complete, blocked, or stopped. This call records the goal; prose records nothing. Keep the full objective. No confirmation needed (the user sees a receipt and can /goal pause or clear). Only one unfinished goal at a time.

objective.description: The full objective to pursue. Keep the complete user goal, not a shortened one-turn version.

token_budget.description: Only set if the user gave a budget.

name: edit
description: Edit one file with targeted text replacements. Every edits[].oldText must identify a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. Merge nearby or overlapping changes into one edit.

edits.description: One or more disjoint replacements, all matched against the original file.

newText.description: Replacement text; may be empty to delete the matched span.

oldText.description: Text identifying one unique region to replace.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute).

name: file_search
description: Find workspace files by name, path, or glob (e.g. src/**/*.rs). Space-separated terms must all match. Literal matches rank above fuzzy matches; results are capped. Respects ignore files and skips build/dependency directories by default. Use extensions to filter suffixes.

exclude.description: Optional replacement exclusion globs (e.g. ["**/target/**", "*.lock"]); [] disables default exclusions.

extensions.description: Optional list of file extensions to include (e.g. ["rs", "md"]).

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked results to return (default: 20, maximum: 200).

path.description: Optional base path to search (relative to workspace).

query.description: File name, path fragment, space-separated terms, or glob (e.g. **/engine*.rs).

name: grep_files
description: Search for a regex pattern in workspace files. The pure-Rust search skips common non-code directories by default and returns matching lines with context.

case_insensitive.description: Whether to perform case-insensitive matching (default: false)

context_lines.description: Number of context lines before and after each match (default: 2)

exclude.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude (e.g., ['*.min.js', 'node_modules/*'])

include.description: Glob patterns for files to include (e.g., ['*.rs', '*.ts'])

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 100)

path.description: Directory or file to search (relative to workspace, default: .)

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to search for

name: list_dir
description: List entries in a workspace directory, bounded and sandbox-aware.

path.description: Path to inspect (relative to workspace, absolute, or ~/ home-relative; default: .)

name: load_skill
description: Load a named skill's SKILL.md body and companion file list into this turn. There is no skills index in the prompt: pass query="..." to search names, aliases, and descriptions, or name="list" for project and Codewhale skills. Use include_external=true to list global compatible skills too. Load the matching skill by name before starting that work. Resolves global and plugin skills that `read` cannot reach.

include_external.description: Include individual global compatible skills in the list instead of only their counts.

name.description: Skill id to load. Omit or pass "list" for the compact catalogue, or "list-all" to include global compatible skills.

query.description: Words matched against skill names, aliases, and descriptions, including global compatible skills.

name: present
description: Declare existing workspace files as final deliverables and return a handoff receipt. Read-only: the files are not modified, moved, copied, or uploaded. For each of 1-32 workspace-relative paths it records the display path, byte length, and SHA-256. Call it after finishing an artifact so the tool call is the presentation point. It does not create a delivery folder or a second artifact store.

files.description: Workspace-relative paths of existing regular files to present (1-32, no duplicates).

note.description: Optional short note about the presented artifacts.

name: read
description: Read a file. Returns up to 2000 lines per call within a 51200-byte output cap; a line longer than 2000 chars is truncated with a marker. Use offset and limit to read a line range or continue a large file; the footer names the next offset. Responses report byte size, line count, and truncated. PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP return as visible image content (large images downscaled); read an image instead of OCR or screenshots.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. Defaults to 2000.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed).

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute).

name: todo_write
description: Replace the To-do list the user watches. For any task with three or more steps or more than one file, write the list before you start, keep exactly one item in_progress, and mark items done as you finish them. Skip it only for a single quick answer or edit.

todos.description: The complete list of To-do items. This replaces the existing list.

name: write
description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it does not exist, overwrites it if it does, and creates parent directories automatically.

content.description: Content to write to the file.

line_ending.description: Default: preserve existing endings. Explicit lf/crlf converts CRLF and lone CR.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute).

name: tool_search
description: Search deferred tool definitions and return matching references. Deferred tools include `Git`, `Web`, `tasks`, `request_user_input`, `github`, `automation`, `review`, `context_archive_search`, `context_archive_get`, `registry_sync`, `start_registry_mcp_server`, and tools from connected MCP servers. Calling one by name also loads it.

match.description: Matching algorithm: bm25 for natural-language matching, regex for a regular expression over tool names/descriptions/schema.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching tool references to return.
